name: Exciting Milk Dai 2 Wa
original_name: エキサイティングみるく第 2 話
source:
Amon transfers to the same class as Kurumi. He's very moved by the fact that seaweed still exists in 20th century and is going to liberate it by animating it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-january-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
阿蒙转学到与狂三同班。海藻在20世纪仍然存在，他将通过赋予它生命来解放它，这让他非常感动。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-january-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
